title: The Rhubarb Barge of Inversion Day
description: On Inversion Day, the river takes to the sky. A barge made from a single rhubarb leaf carries the spring harvest above the village bridge.
alt: A giant pink and green rhubarb-leaf barge sails along a ribbon of water in the sky as a person in a yellow coat watches from a stone bridge.
pairing: An imagined holiday when the river runs overhead × a barge made from a rhubarb leaf
